Specification: This module provides placeholder definitions for real-number-related operators rather than a full executable semantics. It models a dummy Reals module by defining a distinguished value Real, division as a CHOOSE-based operator over that value, and Infinity as a CHOOSE of an element outside Real that is greater than every element of Real. The file does not define a transition system, state variables, actions, temporal specification, fairness, or proofs; it is a mathematical support module intended for use by other specifications and tools.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE m \in Real : m * b = a
CHOOSE i : (i \notin Real) /\ (\A r \in Real : i > r)
